outcome: Replace delayed, fragmented financial reporting with a governed data platform and a reconciled first reporting domain.
overview: Give finance and data teams one reconciled reporting domain with an accountable owner. Start with a daily balances or exception report. Reduce manual preparation and establish an operating pattern for later domains. Proposed design, with India as the first target market.
kpi: Time from source availability to an accepted report, with reconciliation success rate
scope: Planning estimate: six to eight weeks after access readiness. Deliver one ingestion pipeline, a reconciled report set, access matrix, lineage evidence and a runbook. Run parallel reporting through an agreed period before cutover. The finance owner signs off calculations. The data platform owner accepts operation and recovery.

prerequisites: An agreed scope and a named project owner
Subject matter experts available during delivery
